DETERMINISTIC TASK EXECUTION KERNEL
NO FALLBACKS. NO RETRIES. NO GHOST BEHAVIOR.
ONE INVOCATION. ONE PATH. ONE OUTCOME.
Theme: mintwave  Toggle: DOPETASK_NEON=0

                                                                                                                                
 Usage: dopetask [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                
 dopeTask - Minimal Task Packet Lifecycle CLI                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version                     Show dopeTask version and exit.                                                                │
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.                                                      │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize the installation.               │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ worship           Console-only easter egg (no artifacts).                                                                    │
│ init              Bootstrap dopeTask integration into the current repository.                                                │
│ compile-tasks     Compile task packets from spec.                                                                            │
│ run-task          Execute a task packet (create run workspace).                                                              │
│ collect-evidence  Collect verification evidence from a task run.                                                             │
│ gate-allowlist    Run allowlist compliance gate on a task run.                                                               │
│ promote-run       Promote a task run by issuing completion token.                                                            │
│ commit-run        Create git commit for a task run (allowlist-enforced).                                                     │
│ spec-feedback     Generate spec feedback from completed runs.                                                                │
│ loop              Run complete task packet lifecycle loop.                                                                   │
│ commit-sequence   Execute the COMMIT PLAN defined in the Task Packet.                                                        │
│                   Creates one commit per step, staging only allowlisted changed files.                                       │
│                   Refuses to run on main branch.                                                                             │
│                   Refuses if index contains pre-staged changes.                                                              │
│ finish            Finalize a Task Packet run.                                                                                │
│                   Rebases task branch onto origin/main, fast-forwards main,                                                  │
│                   pushes to remote, verifies sync, and optionally cleans up.                                                 │
│ orchestrate       Run dopeTask orchestrator v0 for a packet.                                                                 │
│ doctor            Run installation integrity checks and generate DOCTOR_REPORT.                                              │
│ upgrade           Upgrade dopeTask in the current repository.                                                                │
│ ci-gate           Run CI gate checks (doctor + promotion validation).                                                        │
│ ops               Manage operator system instructions.                                                                       │
│ neon              Neon terminal cosmetics (console-only). Artifacts stay sterile.                                            │
│ metrics           Local-only opt-in usage metrics (no telemetry).                                                            │
│ tp                Task Packet workflow commands                                                                              │
│ tmux              Manage Task Packet execution in tmux sessions.                                                             │
│ manifest          Task packet manifest lifecycle and replay checks                                                           │
│ wt                Worktree lifecycle commands for deterministic packet execution                                             │
│ docs              Documentation maintenance commands                                                                         │
│ route             Assisted deterministic routing commands                                                                    │
│ pr                Assisted pull request flow commands                                                                        │
│ dopemux           Dopemux-integrated dopeTask commands with automatic path detection                                         │
│ project           Project file initialization and directive pack toggles                                                     │
│ bundle            Case bundle management commands                                                                            │
│ case              Case audit commands                                                                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
